items.source: a Receiptable for tracking receipts
items.translation: 用于跟踪收据的 Receiptable

items.source: An overloaded version of acknowledge(String, boolean) with full StompHeaders instead of just a messageId.
items.translation: 带有完整 StompHeaders 而不是仅 messageId 的 acknowledge(String, boolean) 的重载版本。

items.source: An overloaded version of subscribe(String, StompFrameHandler) with full StompHeaders instead of just a destination.
items.translation: 重载版本的subscribe(String, StompFrameHandler)，使用完整的StompHeaders而不仅仅是目的地。

items.source: Variant of disconnect() with headers.
items.translation: 带有标头的 disconnect() 变体。

items.source: An overloaded version of send(String, Object) with full StompHeaders instead of just a destination.
items.translation: 一个重载版本的 send(String, Object)，使用完整的 StompHeaders 而不是仅指定目的地。

items.source: An overloaded version of send(String, Object) with full StompHeaders instead of just a destination. The headers must contain a destination and may also have other headers such as "content-type" or custom headers for the broker to propagate to subscribers, or broker-specific, non-standard headers.
items.translation: 这是 `send(String, Object)` 的重载版本，使用完整的 StompHeaders 而不仅仅是目的地。标头必须包含一个目的地，还可以包含其他标头，例如 "content-type" 或自定义标头，以便代理传播给订阅者，或者包含代理特定的非标准标头。

items.source: Send a message to the specified destination, converting the payload to a byte[] with the help of a MessageConverter.
items.translation: 向指定的目的地发送消息，借助 MessageConverter 将负载转换为 byte[]。

items.source: Subscribe to the given destination by sending a SUBSCRIBE frame and handle received messages with the specified StompFrameHandler.
items.translation: 通过发送 SUBSCRIBE 帧订阅给定的目的地，并使用指定的StompFrameHandler处理接收到的消息。

items.source: Disconnect the session by sending a DISCONNECT frame.
items.translation: 通过发送 DISCONNECT 帧断开会话。

items.source: Return the id for the session.
items.translation: 返回会话的 ID。

items.source: Whether the session is connected.
items.translation: 会话是否已连接。

items.source: payload - the message payload
items.translation: payload - 消息负载

items.source: handler - the handler for received messages
items.translation: handler - 接收消息的处理程序

items.source: consumed - whether the message was consumed or not
items.translation: consumed - 消息是否已被消费

items.source: a handle to use to unsubscribe and/or track receipts
items.translation: 用于取消订阅和/或跟踪收据的句柄。

items.source: Note: to use this when subscribing you must set the ack header to "client" or "client-individual" in order ot use this.
items.translation: 注意： 在订阅时使用此功能，必须将 ack 头设置为 "client" 或 "client-individual"。

items.source: A receipt header can also be added manually through the overloaded methods that accept StompHeaders.
items.translation: 收据标头也可以通过接受StompHeaders的重载方法手动添加。

items.source: When enabled, a receipt header is automatically added to future send and subscribe operations on this session, which causes the server to return a RECEIPT.
items.translation: 启用后，此会话上未来的`send`和`subscribe`操作会自动添加收据头，导致服务器返回一个 RECEIPT。

items.source:
Represents a STOMP session with operations to send messages,
create subscriptions and receive messages on those subscriptions.
items.translation: 表示一个 STOMP 会话，包含发送消息、创建订阅以及在这些订阅上接收消息的操作。

items.source: A handle to use to track receipts.
items.translation: 用于跟踪收据的句柄。

items.source: A handle to use to unsubscribe or to track a receipt.
items.translation: 用于取消订阅或跟踪收据的句柄。

items.source:
Send an acknowledgement whether a message was consumed or not resulting
in an ACK or NACK frame respectively.
items.translation: 发送一个确认消息是否被消费的消息，分别导致 ACK 或 NACK 帧。

items.source: destination - the destination to send a message to
items.translation: destination - 发送消息的目标地址

items.source: headers - the message headers
items.translation: headers - 消息头

items.source: destination - the destination to subscribe to
items.translation: destination - 要订阅的目标

items.source: headers - the headers for the subscribed message frame
items.translation: headers - 订阅消息帧的头部

items.source: messageId - the id of the message
items.translation: messageId - 消息的 ID

items.source: headers - the headers for the ACK or NACK message frame
items.translation: headers - ACK 或 NACK 消息帧的头部

items.source: headers - the headers for the disconnect message frame
items.translation: headers - 断开连接消息帧的头部
